laws: OBJECT IDENTITY != BYTE HASH != PROJECTION ADDRESS
promotion_rule: Keep /contact/ simple. Promote deeper mechanisms onto /port/ only when they reduce real interaction/re-entry cost.

ordinary use: override LIKELY when cue support is wrong
re-enter Port from a downstream tool and confirm source/focus restoration is useful rather than sticky
observe whether SELECT → OPEN adds useful deliberation or needless friction
do not expand cue grammar or add transport until ordinary evidence accumulates

add TEXT/JSON apertures from shared Field Aperture
add IMAGE whole/normalized-region focus via canvas aperture
retain generic files as addressable objects even without a semantic viewer
keep heuristic CUES and local HISTORY as separate readings

support_semantics.non_claim: Route cue counts suggest attention; they do not prove route compatibility, confidence, importance or permission.

reality_gate: drop one real generated image → hash → region focus → FIELD INTAKE candidate → APPLY or reject → RETURN

next: Do not add audio/video/PDF or AI auto-routing until the three unequal object specimens survive ordinary use.
